svg.title: Two different denominators in Hunt’s article
svg.desc: 1997 and 2017: The article compares home ownership among people aged 25 to 34.. England in 2024: The article counts those under 35 among all homeowners.. Interpretation: A share of young people differs from a share of property owners.

g.text: Two different denominators in Hunt’s article
The article compares home ownership among people aged 25 to 34.
The article counts those under 35 among all homeowners.
A share of young people differs from a share of property owners.
